scope: Quiet-scan unit only. Real CoreStore + real createStoreAutoTitleDispatcher via the unchanged factory signature; deterministic per-side 1 Hz logical clocks inside the 600 s backoff cap; sidecar bookkeeping seeded identically on both sides from the BEFORE module's own normalization/signature helpers, so no scan ever launches and the provider throws if one does. Giant mailboxes are offline-seeded rows (labeled offlineMailboxRows; they add ZERO audit rows, asserted via lastAuditSeq) with INTERLEAVED pending/delivered history (every row except each third delivered by the bee's real generation 1, every third remaining pending, interleaved throughout; distribution recorded), and EVERY offline row is proven byte-equal to the public PK read across all nine MessageRow fields outside timing. Timing spans AWAITED dispatcher completion; state oracles, SQL tracing, and allocation sampling run separately. The SQL replay captures the scan's SYNCHRONOUS entry only — an accepted design must itself prove quiet work stays synchronous. The first-scan figures are the first dispatcher scan against prepared fixture/page caches in a warm process, NOT cold-process/cold-OS numbers; warmed ABBA rounds follow. Allocation numbers are V8 sampled allocation traffic, not retained RAM; no retained-memory, write-tradeoff, launch, changed-content, launch-order, or giant-fleet-stress claims — those belong to other units. Same-process GC and OS caches may cross sides. Structural smoke runs on a contended workstation prove wiring, not performance.
